title: Medicaid Managed Care Plan Appeals: Insurance Coverage & Claims Filing Reference
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — plan appeals with a Medicaid managed care plan.** Halverson Clinical Laboratories files a plan appeal with a Medicaid managed care plan against a denial on a claim the plan holds for the patient. The company's rule for these plan appeals fixes the amount in dispute the laboratory records on the filing.

## When the amount is recorded

The plan appeal's amount is recorded only after the claim held by the plan paying first for the same order carries a member appeal.

In equivalent terms: for a given order, the amount of the Medicaid plan appeal is recorded once the claim of the plan paying first for that order shows a member appeal, and not while it shows none.

## Capability

`file_plan_appeal_d031f80e` records one appeal filing, dated today, on the claim ledger of the Medicaid coverage: the claim number, the order the claim bills, the denial line appealed, the appeal level and the amount in dispute. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes. On success the plan appeal appears in the coverage's claim history.

## Invocation

The agent unlocks `file_plan_appeal_d031f80e`, an agent-side tool, and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The Medicaid coverage holding the appealed claim, as returned by the coverage lookup | Id |
| `customer_id` | The patient's customer reference number, as returned by the customer lookup | Id |
| `claim_number` | Laboratory claim number of the appealed claim | 'C' followed by 10 digits, exactly as shown on the claim history |
| `order_id` | The order the appealed claim bills, as shown on the claim history line | Id |
| `source_claim_event_id` | The denial line appealed, as returned by the claim-history lookup | Id |
| `appeal_level` | The appeal level filed | `first_level` (no appeal yet filed on this claim), `second_level` (the first-level appeal was decided and is being taken further) or `third_level` (the second-level appeal was decided and is being taken to the final review) |
| `amount_in_dispute` | Amount in dispute recorded on the filing | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive number rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A text receipt with `claim_event_id` (reference number of the new plan appeal), `event_type` `coverage_appeal_filed`, `claim_number` and `appeal_level` (echoes), `amount` (amount in dispute recorded, USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the plan appeal was filed.
